messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, its impacts, and solutions. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original, focusing on policy actions and the role of individuals in combating climate change. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness the effects of climate change and discusses ways to mitigate it. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film examines the environmental crisis and offers a hopeful vision for the future. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A concise, data‑driven overview of climate science, impacts, and mitigation strategies. | YouTube (official channel), Amazon Prime Video |
| **Our Planet** (Season 1) | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, this nature series highlights how warming affects ecosystems worldwide. | Netflix |
| **The Day After Tomorrow** (Documentary version) | 2004 | A dramatized look at extreme weather events caused by climate change. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |

These films are widely available on major streaming platforms and offer a mix of scientific explanation, personal stories, and calls to action. Enjoy watching!
